WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM web_sales
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period;
